messages:
emily: Quick heads-up — opened a small PR to adjust the region availability table and a tiny SDK snippet for geo endpoints. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4123 :wave:

mike: Nice, thanks. Is this just text changes or do we need a migration guide for customers?

emily: Mostly text + one code snippet change. But we should add a 1‑line migration note in the SDK section — some customers use the old `region` param in examples.

sarah: Can you paste the snippet here? I can incorporate it and run the link-checker.

emily: Sure — current example uses the old path. Want to update to the new endpoint param and show the SDK pattern.

emily: ```js
// old
client.generate({ model: 'x-large', region: 'eu' })

// new (recommended)
client.generate({ model: 'x-large', endpoint: 'https://eu.api.redwood.ai' })
```

alex: That new form is correct. Also note: for Dedicated customers we recommend pinning model version + region in the console rather than passing endpoint in code. Maybe add a one-liner about that.

mike: Agree. Also please add a short note about data residency: "requests to eu endpoints keep logs in eu by default" — legal asked for explicit wording.

emily: On it. Drafted this sentence: "Data processed through our EU endpoints is logged and stored within EU regions unless your account is configured for a different residency; contact support for bespoke contracts." Thoughts?

sarah: Good wording. Can you wrap that into a small callout and add the link to the residency FAQ? Use /residency (docs) anchor.

emily: Added: "See https://docs.redwood.ai/residency#eu for details and legal caveats." Also updated the region matrix row for APAC latency expectations (added ~20–80ms note).

docs-bot: link-checker found failing link: https://docs.redwood.ai/residency#eu -> 404 (PR branch).

emily: Ugh. The anchor changed on main. I'll fix the link in the PR and push.

alex: Quick tip — rather than hard anchor, link to /residency and the subsection title, e.g., https://docs.redwood.ai/residency#data-residency-eu — more stable.

mike: Also leave a note in the PR description about back-compat: customers using `region` param will still work for now but should migrate within 60 days. Ops ok with that?

alex: Ops confirmed in the ticket. 60 days is fine. We'll surface a deprecation warning in the SDK logs for the next two releases.

sarah: I'll review the PR after the link fix. If it's small, we can merge and cherry-pick the APAC latency note to the 1.2 release notes.

emily: Pushed fix and updated PR description with migration note + link to changelog draft. https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4123

docs-bot: link-checker passed on latest push. :white_check_mark:

mike: Great — anyone wants to add a brief example snippet for curl showing endpoint override for non-SDK clients?

emily: Added a curl example in the PR body:

emily: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"x-large","input":"Hello"}'
```

sarah: LGTM. I'll merge after CI. If CI is green, cherry-pick into release branch and tag in release notes.

alex: I can follow up with the SDK team to add the deprecation warning. Filing a tiny task: REDWOOD-SDK-789.

emily: Thanks all, merging after CI. Will ping infra if any follow-ups. :rocket:
